title: Why Leaves Change Color: The Big Picture

scenes.title: THE WHOLE AUTUMN STORY
scenes.caption: A leaf changes as the tree prepares for winter.
scenes.narration: Autumn color is a visible sign of a deeper seasonal process. The tree is preparing to rest through colder, darker months.

scenes.title: FROM GREEN TO GOLD
scenes.caption: Chlorophyll fades and carotenoids show.
scenes.narration: As chlorophyll breaks down, hidden yellow and orange carotenoids become visible. That is the source of many golden autumn leaves.

scenes.title: FROM GOLD TO CRIMSON
scenes.caption: Anthocyanins add vivid red and purple.
scenes.narration: Some trees also produce anthocyanins, creating red and purple shades. Weather and species influence how strong those colors become.

scenes.title: NUTRIENTS RETURN HOME
scenes.caption: The tree recovers resources from its leaves.
scenes.narration: Before leaves fall, trees reclaim valuable nutrients and store them for spring. The changing colors happen during this careful recovery.

scenes.title: THE CYCLE CONTINUES
scenes.caption: Fallen leaves return nutrients to the forest.
scenes.narration: After falling, leaves decompose and return nutrients to the soil. The forest reuses what the previous season produced.

scenes.title: NEXT SPRING
scenes.caption: New leaves begin the cycle again.
scenes.narration: When warmth and longer days return, buds open and new leaves grow. Now you know the science behind autumn's changing colors.
